currentContext.expansion: K. V. Toys expands capacity through partnerships rather than owned plant. As at FY26 the Company operated an asset-light model with 15 dedicated OEM partners contributing 100% dedicated partner capacity, one owned unit, one joint-venture manufacturing unit and over 1 lakh sq. ft. of assembly and warehousing infrastructure. The FY26 expansion programme was executed through three new entities rather than a capex project: Indo Manufacturers LLP (55% subsidiary LLP, incorporated 13 March 2026) to strengthen backward integration and manufacturing capability; Crayonix Stationery Private Limited (65% subsidiary, incorporated 5 March 2026) to enter stationery, gifting and educational products; and Just Bear Private Limited (27% associate, incorporated 29 November 2025) to enter soft toys and plush products. The Company also acquired the business of KV Impex, amended its Objects Clause to cover household plastic products and their raw materials, listed on the BSE SME platform on 15 December 2025, and initiated exports with its first commercial shipment to Germany. Stated forward priorities are to enhance backward integration, improve sourcing efficiencies, strengthen packaging capabilities and expand assembly infrastructure through strategic OEM partnerships. No commissioning dates, capacity additions in physical units, or rupee capex quantum are disclosed for any of these initiatives.
